newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel silent on forex control rumours.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel silent on forex control rumours.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel on Wednesday declined to answer questions as to whether President Nelson Mandela would make an announcement on the relaxation of foreign exchange controls this week.
"I've seen some very interesting rumours in the market," Manuel told reporters, declining further comment on the matter.
There has been mounting speculation that Mandela will use his opening of parliament address on Friday to announce fresh steps in dismantling exchange controls on residents.
Foreign exchange dealers said the talk was particularly widespread in foreign markets, contributing to current euphoria in financial markets which lifted the rand to a four-month on Wednesday.
